content: Use uploaded image as the permanent character identity, outfit, and vibe reference for the entire video. Important: the uploaded image is a character sheet reference only. Use it to preserve Adriana’s identity, hairstyle, outfit, expressions, and overall personality. Do NOT place the character sheet itself inside the video. Do NOT show the sheet layout, labels, boxes, handwritten notes, or collage elements as part of the footage. The final result must look like real digicam footage, not an animated scrapbook. MAIN CHARACTER: Same exact girl throughout the whole video: Adriana. Preserve her identity very closely in every shot: same face, smile, skin tone, curly hair, proportions, and overall recognizable appearance. No face morphing, no identity drift, no hairstyle change, no age change, no outfit change. OUTFIT: Black spaghetti-strap top, loose white cardigan hanging from the shoulders, faded blue jeans. Keep the same outfit consistently in all scenes. PERSONALITY: Playful, cheerful, spontaneous, naturally expressive, warm, youthful, relaxed, comfortable talking to camera. Frequent soft smiles, small laughs, subtle eye expressions, natural blinking, effortless campus-girl energy. VIDEO STYLE: Authentic early-2010s Sony Cyber-shot digicam aesthetic. Old CCD rendering, harsh direct flash, slight overexposure, soft digital grain, compression artifacts, slight chromatic softness, imperfect white balance, tiny autofocus hunting, nostalgic point-and-shoot flaws. The footage should feel like old memory-card video found years later. POV RULE: Entire video is seen from a Sony Cyber-shot LCD camera POV in a dark surrounding environment. The viewer always feels they are watching through a glowing camera screen. Outside the LCD area, everything fades softly into darkness and blur. UI OVERLAYS: Visible camera overlays during the whole video: REC icon, focus indicators, battery icon, timestamp “8.1.2012 3:15 AM”, exposure info “1/30 F3.4 ISO100”. Include realistic LCD glare and screen texture. LANGUAGE RULE: All spoken dialogue must be in natural Spanish. Do not use Indonesian. Do not use English dialogue. DURATION: Exactly 15 seconds. SCENES: 0:00–0:02 Library. Adriana walks slowly between bookshelves filming herself. Slight handheld shake. She smiles and says softly: “Estoy en la biblioteca a estas horas… está súper tranquila y me encanta.” 0:02–0:04 She stops near a manga shelf, turns slightly sideways, laughs naturally, hair falling softly over part of her cheek. 0:04–0:06 Campus stairs. She walks downstairs while filming herself. Natural shake with footsteps. Students behind. 0:06–0:08 Glass campus corridor. She walks backward facing the camera. Afternoon sunlight enters. Soft lens flare. She says: “Hoy hay un ambiente súper bonito, no sé… me gusta mucho.” 0:08–0:10 Outdoor campus area. She briefly turns the camera toward trees and students, then back to her face. 0:10–0:12 Mall bookstore. She walks holding a drink. Direct flash creates bright highlights on skin and cardigan, darker background. 0:12–0:13.5 In front of store glass. Subtle camera reflection visible. She adjusts her hair and laughs softly. 0:13.5–0:15 Close-up. Adriana waves at the camera and says: “Vale, luego sigo grabando.” Brief freeze-frame feeling. REC flashes. Cut to black.

La lumière du soleil de l'après-midi entre. Doux effet de lentille. Elle dit : "Hoy hay un ambiente súper bonito, no sé… me gusta mucho." 0:08–0:10 Zone extérieure du campus. Elle tourne brièvement la caméra vers les arbres et les étudiants, puis revient à son visage. 0:10–0:12 Librairie du centre commercial. Elle marche en tenant une boisson. Le flash direct crée des reflets lumineux sur la peau et le cardigan, arrière-plan plus sombre. 0:12–0:13.5 Devant la vitre du magasin. Réflexion subtile de la caméra visible.
